exact_statement: For every indicator g on a finite uniform physical cube with actual connected components g_k, every nonempty proper r-coordinate block A, and retained coordinate Y, define m_ky=E_A g_k, W_A=sum_k E_Y m_ky log2(1/m_ky), Q_A=E_Y m_y log2(1/m_y), and Omega_A=E_Y m_y H((m_ky/m_y)_k). Then W_A=Q_A+Omega_A=p[r-H(X_A|Y,L,g=1)] and E_A(g)>=W_A/2, with no component-projection separation hypothesis. The original-label raw component excess satisfies Delta_root=X_A+Z_A<=Gamma_A+Z_A with Z_A=E_actual_child Delta_child and Gamma_A=[rp+(2/ln2)E_A(g)-sum_k Lambda_A(g_k)]_+; Z_A is never discarded. For the actual sign f=1-2g, W_A>=rp/2 implies L_A(f)<=C I_A(f), C=4+2/ln2+4/(e ln2)<37/4. Thus physical-descendant ratio-critical sources in this class have H/I<=C, and least-essential-dimension K-violations at K>=C are excluded with all actual child reserves retained. For every such minimal violation and every proper block at K>a=2/ln2+4/(e ln2), H(X_A|Y,L,g=1)>=r[1-2/(K-a)]+(D_K+S_A)/(2p(K-a)). At essential dimension n>=2 this forces sum_k(p_k/p)log2|U_k|>=(n-1)[1-2/(K-a)]+(D_K+S_A)/(2p(K-a)) for any n-1 cut; in particular at K>=C both sign level sets contain a component larger than2^((n-1)/2). Universal paid-block admission is not asserted.
hypotheses: Finite uniform physical cubes; actual Boolean signs and indicators; Fourier and Shannon entropy in bits
Components are actual connected components in the physical cube; their original labels are retained after restricting queried coordinates
Block is proper and nonempty; p>0 where conditional laws or ratios are used; zero fibers contribute zero
Payment condition is W_A>=r p/2; overlapping projections and connected support are allowed
Criticality conclusions use actual physical descendants; minimal fixed-K violation means least essential dimension among all Boolean K-violations
The terminal component excess is signed and is retained in the exact ledger; no uncontrolled terminal is certified or discarded

proof_dependencies.used_scope: Universal block transfer (5), raw row logarithmic Sobolev normalization; not the old disjoint-projection hypothesis
